items.question: Are employees working in UAE free zones generally governed by the UAE Labour Law?
items.gold: No, they are generally not governed by the UAE Labour Law; each free zone authority has its own employment law.
items.fact: Free zone employees generally not governed by UAE Labour Law

items.question: Who sponsors employees working in a UAE free zone?
items.gold: The respective free zone authority sponsors them, not their employer.
items.fact: Free zone employees sponsored by free zone authority, not employer
